newsitem.title: INDIA: Essar, Premier may cut Ratna stakes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Essar, Premier may cut Ratna stakes - paper.

text.p: India's Essar Group and Britain's Premier Oil Plc are in talks with foreign oil companies to reduce their stakes in the Ratna oilfield development venture, the Financial Express daily said on Monday.
Officials at Essar, which has a 50-percent share in the project, declined to comment immediately on the report but said the group would issue a statement on the matter very shortly.
Citing oil industry sources in New Delhi, the newspaper said Essar had held talks recently with U.S. major Atlantic Richfield Co and the Italian energy group ENI.
Sources also told the paper that Premier Oil might give up all of its 10-percent stake in the project.
The other 40 percent share in the venture is held by the state-owned Oil and Natural Gas Commission.

However, the paper said Essar officials had maintained that there would be no change in the ownership structure and also quoted a Premier Oil official in Singapore denying any move by the British firm to quit the project.
